title: Hideout Menu
intro: A redesign of the drinks and food menus for an international cocktail bar in Busan. From a quick-drink dive bar towards a place worth staying for.
brief: Hideout's old menus were rough, black laminated A5 sheets that suited an underground bar. As the bar grew, it wanted to feel more elevated, encourage guests to try its cocktails instead of defaulting to the usual, and present its food as a real part of the experience.
did: For the drinks menu, I made a surreal collage for each section, built around the bartenders' favourite drink from that section. The aim was playful but elevated: something that makes guests curious enough to order something new.
The food got its own menu, printed large and kept clean, so the dishes could carry it, supporting the bar's shift from a quick drink towards a fuller night out.
